alex_g: Heads-up: Customer 'ByteCart' hitting 400s from our fn_call path when using json_mode=true. Runtime error: "Function arguments validation failed: missing required key \"line_items\"; received type string for \"line_items\" (expected array)". Request-ID: rc-7823. Latency spikes ~900ms before the 400. Attaching logs + repro below.

support-bot: Ticket created #SUP-4821 — pinging eng-ml + oncall. ETA requested.

dylan: Can you paste the exact request body they sent? Was this through our SDK or raw curl?

alex_g: They called via JS SDK v0.9.2 with jsonMode: true. Customer-supplied payload (redacted):

```json
{
  "model": "gpt-xxx",
  "json_mode": true,
  "function_call": {
    "name": "create_order",
    "arguments": "{\\\"order_id\\\":\\\"BC-9001\\\",\\\"line_items\\\":\\\"sku1,sku2\\\"}"
  }
}
```

alex_g: Note that function_call.arguments is a string (double-encoded) and inside it line_items is a comma-separated string instead of an array. Validation fails when we deserialize and enforce the declared function schema.

ingrid_s: This looks like the older SDK bug where nested objects/arrays inside function arguments get JSON.stringify applied twice for jsonMode=true. We had a fix in v0.10.0 to avoid double-stringifying. Can you confirm the customer is on v0.9.2 (they are) and whether they pass a raw JSON string or rely on the SDK to encode?

alex_g: Confirmed v0.9.2. Customer says they copied sample from their app (React) so likely SDK-encoded. I asked for the raw HTTP request. Also captured runtime error trace: 

```
[2026-02-15T14:33:12.456Z] validateFnArgs rc-7823 ERROR invalid_type: expected array at path function_call.arguments.line_items, got string \nstack: at validateArgs (/srv/runtime/validators.js:142:21)
```

dylan: Repro steps (bad / returns 400):

```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-xxx","json_mode":true,"function_call":{"name":"create_order","arguments":"{\"order_id\":\"BC-9001\",\"line_items\":\"sku1,sku2\"}"}}'
```

And (good / expected) — send proper JSON args:

```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-xxx","json_mode":true,"function_call":{"name":"create_order","arguments":{"order_id":"BC-9001","line_items":["sku1","sku2"]}}}'
```

oncall-sre: We see many similar rc-* ids in the last 3 hours from the JS SDK agent header. Validation happens after routing, so runtime sees the stringified payload. Quick mitigation: consider adding a tolerant deserializer that tries JSON.parse if function_call.arguments is a string and then coercing comma-strings to arrays for known keys (line_items). That would unblock customers fast.

ingrid_s: Agreed. I'll open an eng-ml PR to add a selective coercion layer in function-args deserializer and a feature flag 'tolerant_fn_args_coerce'. We'll also add a runtime warning in logs and a follow-up task to tighten schema validation later.

dylan: I'll spin up a branch 'tolerant-fncall-coerce-2231' and prototype the parser change. Plan: detect string -> try JSON.parse, if parse yields object, validate; if a field expected as array is string with commas, coerce to array of strings. Add unit tests and a small perf check.

alex_g: Thanks. Short-term workaround for customer: upgrade SDK to v0.10.0 or send the corrected payload (use an actual array). Customer impact: checkout flow blocked, possible revenue impact. They've requested ETA within 2 business hours. Can eng-ml + oncall pick this up as P0? :eyes:

oncall-sre: Acknowledged. Starting hotfix now, will update SUP-4821 with progress.

alex_g: I'll message customer with the workaround and put them on the hotfix queue. Will post updates here.

ingrid_s: Also adding a note to the SDK changelog and docs to call out that function_call.arguments must be proper JSON (not a string) when json_mode=true.

alex_g: Perfect. Closing interim note: assigned to dylan (runtime hotfix) + ingrid (eng-ml PR + docs). Will re-open if customer still sees errors after upgrade.
